content: Tabs Agenda Tab IMPORTANT: If an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} wants to register for or cancel an existing registration for a paid {{variable.Object_Session}} , they must contact the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s organizer. Full Agenda Tab {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can view all of the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Object_Session}} s, which are sorted by date and {{variable.Field_Session_StartTime}} . {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will see the word “REGISTERED” next to the {{variable.Object_Session}} (s) they registered for. {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can register for or cancel registrations for free {{variable.Object_Session}} s. Day 1 Day 2 Day 3 My Agenda Tab Lists the {{variable.Object_Session}} s an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} has registered for, grouped by {{variable.Object_Session}} {{variable.Field_Session_StartDate}} and {{variable.Field_Session_StartTime}} . {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can cancel their registrations for free {{variable.Object_Session}} s. Info Tab {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will see details about the {{variable.Object_Event}} , including the date, times, location, description, and banner image. Directions/Venue The direction and venue map options will be displayed when configured in the {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Ticket (QR Code) {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can use the QR code to check in for their {{variable.Object_Event}} or {{variable.Object_Session}} (s). Attendees (Attendee List) The Attendees tab includes an alphabetical list of {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s who registered for the {{variable.Object_Event}} . {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can use the search feature to search for other {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s at the {{variable.Object_Event}} . NOTE: {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s who have hidden their {{variable.Object_Attendee}} profile will not be visible. More Menu (Additional Configurations) Users can access the system and organization-related action menu items. Change Organizations An organization is a group, university, etc., that is hosting the {{variable.Object_Event}} . {{variable.Product_BlackthoEventNavigator}} app users can click the “More” menu tab, click Change Organization , and select a new organization (if there are multiple organizations available). For example, an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} may have an undergraduate degree from University A and a master’s from University B. If both schools use Blackthorn and have an {{variable.Object_Event}} with {{variable.Field_EV_EnableNavigaAttMobApp}} enabled, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} can switch between the schools to view each school’s events. Switch Events If {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s register for multiple {{variable.Object_Event}} s, they can move between {{variable.Object_Event}} s by clicking the “More” menu tab, clicking Switch Events , and selecting another {{variable.Object_Event}} . Contact Us Clicking Contact Us opens a new screen with the contact form where the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} fills in the fields. The contact form is then sent to the contact email ( {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ContactUsEmail}} ) entered on the {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Contact Us Form {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can contact the Event Organizer by entering the following information in the Contact Us form and clicking Send . First Name Last Name Email Subject Message Blackthorn created the Navigator app; however, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s who need assistance must use the app’s Contact Us feature to contact the Event Organizer. Blackthorn cannot assist individual {{variable.Object_Event}} {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s. If the Contact Us form does not work, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s should contact the Event Organizer from the {{variable.Object_Event}} webpage’s Contact Us form or by directly contacting the organization hosting the {{variable.Object_Event}} . If the Event Organizer needs additional information, they should open a case with {{variable.Link_BlackthornSupport}} . Quick Start Clicking Quick Start takes {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s to the Quick Start guide, where they can learn how to use the app. Pages Upcoming Events {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will see a list of {{variable.Object_Event}} s they registered for. Session Details Page This page lists all the details for a {{variable.Object_Session}} , including the {{variable.Object_Session}} title, description, date, time, availability, and a Register button for each free {{variable.Object_Session}} . To change the registration status for a paid {{variable.Object_Session}} , {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s must contact the Event Organizer. {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will see {{variable.Object_Session}} details such as the {{variable.Field_Session_SessionName}} , {{variable.Field_Session_Description}} , {{variable.Field_Session_StartDate}} , {{variable.Field_Session_StartTime}} , {{variable.Field_Session_EndTime}} , and whether the {{variable.Object_Session}} is free. Register for Free Sessions Go to the Full Agenda tab. Find the {{variable.Object_Session}} you’d like to register for. Swipe left on that {{variable.Object_Session}} . Click Add to Agenda . Attendee List Page Users will see a list of all registered {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s, in alphabetical order, for an {{variable.Object_Event}} . {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can access the list to reference or review participants and search and filter the list of {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s. NOTE: An {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will only see other {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s who haven’t hidden themselves from the Attendee List. Attendee Details Page The Attendee Details screen displays the following information. Attendee Name ( {{variable.Field_Attendee_AttendFullName}} ) X/previously Twitter ( {{variable.Field_Attendee_X}} ) Facebook ( {{variable.Field_Attendee_Facebook}} ) LinkedIn ( {{variable.Field_Attendee_LinkedIn}} ) When an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} clicks another {{variable.Object_Attendee}} 's name on the Attendee Listing page, they will see the other {{variable.Object_Attendee}} ’s full name and social media (if provided). In the navigation at the bottom of the screen, click Attendees . Click an Attendee’s name. Review the information on the Attendee’s detail page. Speakers Details Page Each {{variable.Object_Speaker}} has a page that contains information about their background. Speaker’s name ( {{variable.Field_Speaker_SpeakerFullName}} ) Company ( {{variable.Field_Speaker_Company}} ) Job Title ( {{variable.Field_Speaker_Title}} ) Image/Avatar ( {{variable.Field_Speaker_ImageURL}} ) Social Media Twitter/X ( {{variable.Field_Speaker_Twitter}} ) LinkedIn ( {{variable.Field_Speaker_LinkedIn}} ) Instagram ( {{variable.Field_Speaker_Instagram}} ) Bio ( {{variable.Field_Speaker_Bio}} )
